verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online government portal for filing and managing industrial property rights. Such a service could plausibly offer background automations, like automatic renewals or publication watch alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents manual filing actions such as patent applications, renewals and oppositions. The 'Agendar atendimento' link books a one-off appointment, not a recurring autonomous automation. Nothing in the pack shows user-configurable background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
